scenario: LEXP.7.19 with [LEXP.2.1]: a comparison chain is judged step by step. In `p.a == p.b < p.c` over three `Bytes` slots the first step is an equality and is admitted; the second is an ordering and is refused with DS_VALIDATE_UNORDERED_TYPE. A check that looked only at the chain's first operator would accept this source. PATH PINNED: the per-step walk of the validator (Mercury: `dsc.typecheck` `adjacent_mismatches`, which reports each step at its own operator).
rules_ds:
schema Pkt scope ttl 1_h:
    a: Bytes
    b: Bytes
    c: Bytes

rule r:
    Pkt p where p.a == p.b < p.c
->
    log info "x"
